findings.risk: Turn-1200 territorial dominance can accumulate positive shaping without a win.
findings.recommendation: Zero or decay land shaping after turn 800; never treat draw as success.

findings.risk: Army lead at draw looks like success under dense shaping.
findings.recommendation: Cap army shaping; emphasise general-capture sparse bonus.

findings.risk: Castles produce ongoing army that can raise draw shaping without conversion.
findings.recommendation: Do not reward castle count alone after conversion phase.

findings.risk: draw=0 makes Expander draw loops look as good as mixed W/L at score_rate 0.5.
findings.recommendation: Ablate DRAW_PENALTY (-0.2) vs DRAW_NEUTRAL; require W/D/L promotion metrics.

promotion_rule: Do not promote on score_rate or mean reward alone; require Expander W/D/L and dominant-position conversion.
campaign_gate: 120-minute PPO campaign blocked until qualification-hardening passes.
